summary.text: Mark Vigliotta is the Democratic candidate for Maine State Senate District 33 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Matthew Harrington (R).

According to his campaign website, he is an Associate Organizer with the IAM, a former production machinery mechanic at Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, and a former president of the Maine State Council of Machinists.

paragraphs.text: Vigliotta says on his campaign website that he moved to Maine in 1988, lived in Sanford for nearly a decade and now lives in Lebanon.

The site says he held positions of trust in his union over 15 years, rising from shop steward to president of the Maine State Council of Machinists, which it describes as representing more than 5,000 workers.
Vigliotta advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
His campaign website lists his priorities as higher-paying jobs and better benefits, a fairer tax code, lower energy costs and affordability for working and middle-class families.
The site's issues page also lists better housing options and property tax relief, care, education and careers, and protecting the environment.
